name: Nigeria
gaps: Ibadan Bird Club and Lekki Bird Club mentioned in searches but only Lekki has verified presence through NCF site. Nigerian Bird Atlas Project operates as Facebook group only. West African Ornithological Society mentioned as BirdLife partner but website not verified. Other regional clubs exist but lack findable independent web presence.

groups.name: Nigerian Conservation Foundation
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, coordinating conservation and education.

groups.name: NCF Bird Club
groups.blurb: Volunteer led birding group running walks, field trips and conservation projects across Nigeria.

groups.name: A.P. Leventis Ornithological Research Institute
groups.blurb: Research and training centre for ornithology and bird conservation at University of Jos.

name: Ghana
gaps: Multiple conservation organizations listed on ABC page (A Rocha Ghana, THRESCOAL, NCRC, Friends of the Nation) but no independent verified websites found. Wildlife Clubs of Ghana (junior wing of GWS) mentioned but no standalone presence verified.

groups.name: Ghana Wildlife Society
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, organizing monthly public birdwalks and conservation work.

name: Burkina Faso
gaps: Association Nature et Développement (NATUDEV), AGEREF-CL, ACTAG-PRW, and Wildlife Angel mentioned on ABC page but websites not verified or currently offline. West African Bird DataBase (WABDaB) excluded as it is a global bird recording platform not a local community.

groups.name: NATURAMA
groups.blurb: The national BirdLife partner, coordinating Site Support Groups around Important Bird Areas.

groups.name: Les Anges-Gardiens de la Nature
groups.blurb: Association of ecoguards working on wildlife and environmental protection across Burkina Faso.

groups.name: L'Homme et l'environnement
groups.blurb: Environmental conservation and sustainable development organization working in the region.

name: Senegal
gaps: Nature-Communautés-Développement is the BirdLife partner but website not verified. APALIS and GÉPOC are Casamance ornithological groups, Oceanium de Dakar is mentioned as active, but no independent verified websites located. CSE (Centre de Suivi Ecologique) is an environmental monitoring center focused on coastal and ecological issues, not a birding community. Groups appear to operate but lack findable web presence with public birding participation.

name: Cameroon
gaps: Cameroon Wildlife Conservation Society (CWCS), Environment and Rural Development Foundation (ERuDeF), Cameroon Biodiversity Conservation Society (CBCS), African Nature and Conservation (ANC), and Voice of Nature (VoNat) all mentioned on ABC page but no verified independent websites found. Cameroon has no current BirdLife partner organization listed. Organizations appear to exist but lack findable online presence.

name: Côte d'Ivoire
gaps: Searched for bird clubs and ornithological societies but no findable local organizations with verified websites. No verifiable birding community groups found.

name: The Gambia
gaps: Gambia Bird Guide Association mentioned as operating in the country with a real birding-guide culture, but no verified independent website found. Professional guide services exist but fell outside community scope.
